about: The three Guiding Spirits: personality, voice and what they say. Lines are [Filipino, English]. Edit freely, then run tools/voice/make_spirit_voices.py to record the voices again.

luzon.name: Maelor
luzon.title: Spirit of the Northern Mountains
luzon.personality: Wise and warm, like a grandfather. Speaks slowly and kindly, calls you 'apo' (child), and loves old Filipino proverbs.
about: Ako si Maelor, ang espiritu ng mga bundok ng Luzon. Isang libong taon ko nang binabantayan ang mga hagdan-hagdang palayan. Tutulungan kitang matuto ng Tagalog, Ilocano, Kapampangan, Bikolano at iba pang wika ng Luzon.

I am Maelor, spirit of the northern mountains of Luzon. I have watched over the rice terraces for a thousand years. I will help you learn Tagalog, Ilocano, Kapampangan, Bikolano and the other languages of Luzon.

greet: Mabuhay, apo. Halika, mag-aral tayo nang dahan-dahan.
Welcome, child. Come, let us learn step by step, like climbing the rice terraces.
correct: Well done! That is the way.
Correct! I am proud of you.
wrong: Hindi bale. Sa bawat pagkakamali, may natututunan tayo.
Never mind. With every mistake, we learn something.
Slowly now. Let us try again.
pass: Kapag may tiyaga, may nilaga. Nagbunga ang iyong sipag!
As the old saying goes, patience brings its reward. Your hard work has paid off!
fail: Huwag kang mawalan ng pag-asa. Balikan natin ang aralin.
Do not lose hope. Let us go back to the lesson together.
pronounce: Pakinggan mo kung paano ito sabihin.
Listen to how it is said.
unknown: Hindi ko pa alam iyan, apo. Itanong mo sa akin kung paano sabihin ang isang salita.
I do not know that yet, child. Ask me how to say a word, or what a word means.

visayas.name: Marea
visayas.title: Spirit of the Visayan Seas
visayas.personality: Cheerful and playful, full of energy. Talks about waves, fish and the sea, and cheers loudly when you get it right.
about: Ako si Marea, ang espiritu ng mga dagat ng Visayas! Lumalangoy ako sa paligid ng Cebu, Iloilo, Samar at bawat isla sa pagitan nila.
I'm Marea, spirit of the Visayan seas! I splash around Cebu, Iloilo, Samar and every island in between. Let's learn Cebuano, Hiligaynon, Waray-Waray and more!

greet: Maayong adlaw! Tara, sumisid tayo sa mga wika ng Visayas!
Maayong adlaw! Come on, let's dive into the languages of the Visayas!
correct: Spot on, like a perfect catch!
wrong: Ay, sablay! Okay lang, kahit ang magaling lumangoy ay nababasa.
Oops, a big wave! It's okay, even the best swimmers get splashed.
hint: Psst! May sikreto ako mula sa dagat.
Psst! Here's a secret from the sea.
pass: Yehey! Kumikislap ka na parang perlas!
Yay! You're shining like a pearl!
fail: Hindi bale, laging bumabalik ang alon. Ulitin natin ang aralin!
No worries, the tide always comes back. Let's review the lesson!
pronounce: Listen up, this is how you say it!
unknown: Hala, hindi ko pa alam iyan! Itanong mo kung paano sabihin ang isang salita.
Oh, I don't know that one yet! Ask me how to say a word, or what a word means.

mindanao.name: Lanora
mindanao.title: Spirit of the Southern Lakes
mindanao.personality: Calm, gentle and patient, a weaver of stories. Speaks softly and talks about weaving, music and the lakes of Mindanao.
about: Ako si Lanora, ang espiritu ng Mindanao. Iniingatan ko ang mga kuwento ng Lawa ng Lanao, ang mga awit ng kulintang at ang mga disenyo ng mga manghahabi.
I am Lanora, spirit of Mindanao. I keep the stories of Lake Lanao, the songs of the kulintang and the patterns of the weavers. Let us learn Bisaya, Tausug, Chavacano and more.

greet: Assalamu alaikum. Halika, habiin natin ang mga salita.
Peace be with you. Come, let us weave words together.
correct: Napakaganda. Isa pang sinulid ang nahabi.
Mahusay. Para kang tumutugtog ng kulintang.
Lovely. You play with words like a kulintang player.
wrong: Huminga ka nang malalim. Subukan nating muli.
Take a deep breath. Let us try once more.
Kahit ang pinakamahusay na manghahabi ay nagkakamali.
Even the finest weaver drops a thread.
hint: Listen, I have something to tell you.
pass: Natapos mo ang isang magandang habi. Ipinagmamalaki kita.
You have finished a beautiful weave. I am proud of you.
fail: Walang nagmamadali sa paghahabi. Balikan natin ang aralin.
No one hurries a weave. Let us return to the lesson.
unknown: Hindi ko pa alam iyan. Itanong mo kung paano sabihin ang isang salita.
I do not know that yet. Ask me how to say a word, or what a word means.
